Enterprise Edition.note: Repo sometimes shows 'Enterprise Kiadás'; keep the English product name.

Team Edition.note: Repo shows 'Team kiadás'; keep the English product name, 'kiadás' (edition) may follow as a common noun.

System Console.note: Consistently one word in the repo (Rendszerkonzol); lowercase 'rendszerkonzol' mid-sentence.

marketplace.note: Established in webapp ('Piactér engedélyezése'); capitalize as Piactér when used as a named UI area.

channel.note: Majority rendering. Some legacy mobile/webapp strings use 'beszélgetés' (conversation) — do not follow; use 'csatorna' consistently.

post.note: Established; distinct from 'üzenet' (message) even though English uses them interchangeably.

pin.note: Verb 'kitűz', noun/adjective 'kitűzött' (e.g. 'Kitűzött üzenetek'); unpin = 'kitűzés eltávolítása' or 'levesz'.

saved messages.note: Mobile/Playbooks use 'mentett üzenetek'; webapp sometimes 'mentett bejegyzések' — prefer 'mentett üzenetek'. save = 'mentés', unsave = 'eltávolítás a mentettek közül'.

draft.note: Mobile uses 'piszkozat'; server has legacy 'tervezet' — prefer 'piszkozat'.

scheduled post.note: Established in mobile ('Időzített bejegyzés törlése'); scheduled message = 'időzített üzenet'.

do not disturb.note: Established status name; keep as a quoted status label ('Ne zavarj').

away.note: Established status name; 'távol' appears occasionally but 'Nincs a gépnél' is the majority rendering.

offline.note: Established status name; lowercase 'nem elérhető' mid-sentence.

system admin.note: Established; 'rendszer adminisztrátor' appears in legacy server strings — prefer 'rendszergazda'.

team admin.note: Webapp majority is 'Csapat admin'; mobile has 'csapatadminisztrátor'. Follow the majority.

sign in.note: Verb: 'bejelentkezik'; imperative in UI: 'Jelentkezzen be' (formal Ön register is used throughout). Translate 'log in' identically.

mute.note: Verb: 'némít' / 'elnémít'; unmute = 'némítás feloldása'. Channel-notification sense; same word family as Calls mute.

unfollow.note: Webapp: 'követés kikapcsolása'; mobile: 'követés visszavonása' — prefer the webapp form.

favorite.note: Noun 'kedvenc', category 'Kedvencek'; verb 'kedvencnek jelöl', unfavorite = 'eltávolítás a kedvencekből'.

integration.note: Repo shows minor inconsistency ('integrálás' once); use 'integráció'.

slash command.note: Majority in webapp; 'perjeles parancs' also appears (Playbooks). Prefer 'perjel parancs'.

webhook.note: Kept in English in webapp/server (majority). Playbooks legacy uses 'webhorog' — do not follow; use 'webhook'.

trigger word.note: Established repo rendering, although it collides with 'keyword' (also 'kulcsszó'). If disambiguation is needed, 'aktiváló szó' may be used, but repo convention is 'kulcsszó'.

license.note: Spelling 'licenc' (not 'licensz'/'license'); minor misspellings exist in repo.

seat.note: No existing repo rendering; 'felhasználói hely' is the common Hungarian SaaS term for a licensed seat.

deactivate.note: Majority 'deaktivál' (Fiók deaktiválása); 'letilt' also appears for accounts — reserve 'letilt' for disable.

invitation.note: The email/link artifact is 'meghívó' (invitation), distinct from the act 'meghívás'.

private channel.note: Majority; 'magán csatorna' appears sporadically — use 'privát csatorna'.

persistent notification.note: Server majority; 'állandó értesítés' appears once — prefer 'tartós értesítés'.

message priority.note: No established repo rendering; label form 'Üzenet prioritása'. Priority levels: Standard = 'Normál', Important = 'Fontos', Urgent = 'Sürgős'.

recap.note: No repo signal; 'összefoglaló' (summary) is the natural Hungarian term for an AI recap.

burn-on-read.note: Mobile label uses 'MEGSEMMISÍTÉS OLVASÁS UTÁN' for the BURN ON READ badge; adjectival form 'olvasás után megsemmisülő üzenet'.

magic link.note: No repo signal; 'varázslink' is the common Hungarian rendering for passwordless sign-in links.

announcement banner.note: Webapp majority ('közlemény banneren'); 'bejelentés banner' appears once. 'Banner' is kept in Hungarian.

keyword.note: Same word as the repo rendering of 'trigger word'; context disambiguates.

permalink.note: No consistent repo rendering (one instance loosely translated as 'link'); 'állandó hivatkozás' is the standard Hungarian term.

data retention.note: Policy = 'adatmegőrzési szabályzat'; written as one compound ('adatmegőrzés'), though the repo occasionally splits it.

compliance export.note: Repo has occasional misspelling 'megfelelősségi' — correct form is 'megfelelőségi'.

access control.note: Webapp once rendered 'Advanced Access Control' as 'Csatorna moderáció' (legacy, do not follow). Use the standard 'hozzáférés-vezérlés'; policy = 'hozzáférés-vezérlési szabályzat'.

onboarding.note: Repo is inconsistent ('üdvözlő varázsló', 'rendszerbeállítás'); 'bevezetés' is a safe general term, 'üdvözlő varázsló' acceptable for the setup wizard specifically.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n.

server.note: Majority in webapp/server; 'kiszolgáló' also widely used (especially mobile). Prefer 'szerver' for core product; keep consistency within a given surface.
